description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.06.2017 to 02.07.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and involves compliance requirements for import/export activities - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
